description: This PHP class defines the 'BuzzLikeOnShare' entity for an ORM-managed database, representing a 'like' on a shared post within the OrangeHRM buzz social feature. It includes properties for ID, associated share, employee who liked, and timestamp of the like, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnShare
classes.description: Entity class representing a 'like' on a shared post in the Buzz feature, managed via Doctrine ORM, including relationships to share and employee, and timestamp management.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the like record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the like record.

methods.name: setShare
methods.description: Associates a BuzzShare entity with this like.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee who liked the share.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee with this like.

methods.name: getLikedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the DateTime when the like was made in UTC.

methods.name: setLikedAtUtc
methods.description: Sets the 'liked' time to the current UTC time.
